name: Exposed Filter Data
description: Provides a block that prints the current exposed-filter (URL query) values of a View, e.g. as a "Filtered by:" summary.
project_description: Exposed Filter Data provides a single block plugin, "Exposed Filters Data" (id exposed_filters_data_block), that reads the current request's URL query-string parameters and renders them as a themed "Filtered by: name: value" summary. It is intended to be placed in a View's output (typically the header, e.g. via the Views Block Area module) so that when a View's exposed filters live in a separate block the visitor still sees which filter values produced the current result set. The block renders through the exposed_filter_data_block theme hook (template templates/block--exposed_filter_data.html.twig) and attaches a small CSS library; it only renders when query parameters are present. Sites can rewrite or relabel the raw parameter names/values by implementing hook_exposed_filter_data_params_alter(). The block sets cache max-age 0 so it always reflects the current request. The module ships no configuration, routes, permissions, services or update hooks.
